name: Focused Discipline
benefit:
You gain a +2 bonus on all saving throws against fear effects. Whenever a fear effect targets you and fails to affect you (either because of a successful saving throw or because of immunity to fear), you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and CMB checks against the creature that attempted to use the fear affect on you for 1 round.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 25
You can spend 2 stamina points in order to gain the benefit of Focused Discipline for 1 round as if you had been targeted by a fear effect that failed to affect you.
flavor: Familiarity with the military traditions of your homeland inspires uncommon valor in you.
